scientific_integrity: The minimization is analytic. The k=7/4 negative value is certified by exact integer polynomial reduction and rational interval arithmetic; floating-point values are used only as diagnostics. Boundary negativity is converted to actual interior counterexamples by continuity.
scientific_limitations: The exact profile is optimal only for the specified isosceles boundary family. It does not prove the source conjecture at k=1.73 and does not establish the globally sharp exponent. The zero near 1.7337000816624983 is numerical only; unindexed prior literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact boundary obstruction profile for Liu's Erdős–Mordell exponent conjecture
